rooms.environmentalStory: Fresh expedition gear is arranged around machinery far older than the camp.

exitRules.notes: The primary entry must remain reachable before credentials are acquired.

rooms.mood: Restrictive and confrontational, designed to make every crossing feel observed and earned.
rooms.purpose: Controls progression between factory zones with scanners, blast gates, barriers, and identity checks.

verticalPlan.intent: A discoverable lower bypass through scanner machinery.

rooms.environmentalStory: Scrape marks show that a large dormant unit is moved between the pit and a sealed recharge wing.
rooms.mood: Hostile, improvised, and almost organic despite being made entirely of machinery.
rooms.purpose: Provides a defended den where Reaverbots gather scrap, hatch smaller units, and alter the ruin.

verticalPlan.intent: Destroy cable nodes to reconnect upper spans.

rooms.environmentalStory: Camera records end whenever they turn toward a particular sealed lower corridor.
rooms.mood: Watchful and paranoid, dominated by dead screens and active red camera eyes.
rooms.purpose: Monitors the factory, coordinates security, and reveals routes or events elsewhere in the dungeon.

verticalPlan.intent: Reach cameras and dish controls at separate heights.

rooms.environmentalStory: Discarded machine cores were crushed only after their red eyes had been carefully removed.

exitRules.notes: At least one traversable hazard window must always exist.
Lower exits require a non-damaging recovery route.

rooms.mood: Loud, brutal, and relentlessly mechanical, turning timing and positioning into survival.
rooms.purpose: Crushes, burns, sorts, or disposes of dangerous waste and failed machine components.

verticalPlan.intent: Disable separate machine stages on different levels.

rooms.environmentalStory: The final chassis on the line combines parts from several incompatible Reaverbot models.
rooms.mood: Restless and rhythmic, as fragments of the production line keep working without operators.
rooms.purpose: Constructs or repairs Reaverbots and industrial machinery with conveyors, arms, presses, and gantries.

verticalPlan.intent: Repair machinery below to open the high route.

rooms.environmentalStory: A trail of shutdown commands passes between departments, each refusing responsibility.

exitRules.notes: The entry anchors the internal solvability graph.
All required unlock dependencies must be attainable from the entry.

rooms.mood: Expansive and consequential, like discovering a complete facility hidden inside one dungeon node.
rooms.purpose: Creates a self-contained industrial sub-dungeon with internal branches, mechanisms, encounters, and a final gate.

verticalPlan.intent: Required and optional paths trade between levels.

rooms.environmentalStory: Machine parts have been placed around the pedestal in deliberate concentric offerings.
rooms.mood: Solemn, beautiful, and inscrutable, suggesting the machines were objects of duty or worship.
rooms.purpose: Preserves a culturally important mechanism where factory operations and ancient ritual overlap.

verticalPlan.intent: Carry power from a lower archive to the high shrine.

rooms.environmentalStory: One archive aisle was deliberately fused shut after its memory cores were removed.
rooms.mood: Hushed, uncanny, and reverent; the buried archive seems to notice intruders.
rooms.purpose: Archives refractor-era memory inside shrine-like data machinery and protects access to sealed records.

verticalPlan.intent: Lower cable puzzle with an upper observation route.

rooms.environmentalStory: Production tallies rise after the facility evacuation, then stop mid-cycle.
rooms.mood: Restless and rhythmic, as fragments of the production line keep working without operators.
rooms.purpose: Constructs or repairs Reaverbots and industrial machinery with conveyors, arms, presses, and gantries.

rooms.environmentalStory: Coolant stains mark a former waterline above an intact emergency ladder.
rooms.mood: Claustrophobic, damp, and forceful, with every pipe shudder suggesting a coming rupture.
rooms.purpose: Circulates coolant and pressure through the ruin while governing drains, steam, and turbines.

verticalPlan.intent: Long safe route versus hazardous direct floor route.

rooms.environmentalStory: The rarest vault was opened neatly, while common supplies were scattered in panic.
rooms.mood: Dense and tempting, with every blocked aisle hinting at forgotten valuables or an ambush.
rooms.purpose: Stores salvage, replacement parts, credentials, and sealed cargo for factory operations.

verticalPlan.intent: Unlock exits and spot hidden cargo from above.
